question: Can a degree-at-most-two path/Feshbach correspondence generate the missing A,d terms and canonically select the physical common ray?

generalSelectedReturnMap.A: alpha_x*x^2 + alpha_y*y^2, with alpha_x and alpha_y of inverse-mass dimension
generalSelectedReturnMap.d: beta*x^2, with beta of inverse-mass dimension

degreeTwoClassification.JGradeRelationCompatibility: closed returns are J-even, grading-even and relation-even; primitive edges retain their odd/even assignments

globalPolynomialFailure: creates the forbidden open I--N path x*y
creates P--Z and N--X open length-two support
requiredOperations: diagonal conditional expectation E_diag to remove open length-two paths
endpoint projector Pi_PI to retain returns only at P and I
projectorNecessity.reason: J, grading and relation parity admit closed returns at N,Z,X just as they admit returns at P,I

matrixMultiplicityRepair.status: UNSAT under multiplicity-basis naturality; SAT only after inserting a rank-one multiplicity projector plus Pi_PI

newSectorRepair.multiplicityBasisNaturality: vacuous because every retained chain sector has multiplicity one
newSectorRepair.physicalDimensionalCost: at least one inverse mass scale kappa; setting kappa=1 is only a verifier normalization
newSectorRepair.status: conditional SAT: an explicit degree-two map exists, but it is not selected by J/grading/relation symmetry alone

forbiddenSupportAudit.effectiveLNUnderUnprojectedD2: x*y, nonzero for every bounded nonzero assignment
forbiddenSupportAudit.interpretation: the successful map preserves primitive support only because it includes a new path-type projector

decision.candidate: primitive four-chain plus kappa Pi_PI E_diag(D_chain^2)
decision.matrixMultiplicityBranch: UNSAT without a new rank-one multiplicity projector
decision.newSectorBranch: SAT only with E_diag and Pi_PI supplied as new structural data
decision.exactMinimumNewDatum: an inverse mass scale kappa and selected-return conditional expectation Pi_PI E_diag; the multiplicity repair additionally needs a rank-one projector in each doubled multiplicity space
decision.strongestConclusion: length-two returns can generate the missing diagonals and preserve the cofactor, but neither path algebra nor the declared symmetries choose which returns survive or select the common mediator ray

boundary: The classification includes primitive degree-one edges and all length-two paths on the five-chain, with real endpoint coefficients and the inherited J/grade/relation assignments. Higher paths, energy-dependent inverses and added auxiliary masses are outside the bound.
